prompt_inputs.goal: Muscle recovery and strength gains from weightlifting training

solution_criteria: Includes 4-5 meals with protein distributed across each meal (minimum 25-30g per meal)
Contains specific pre-workout meal (1-2 hours before training) and post-workout meal (within 1 hour after training)
Provides realistic, compact meal descriptions with approximate calorie and macronutrient content
task_description: Write a compact consice one day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a strength/power athlete (weightlifter) focusing on protein distribution across meals and pre/post-workout nutrition for muscle recovery

prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - high carbohydrate intake with strategic timing around 20km run

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers one full day with breakfast, lunch, dinner, and pre/post-workout meals
Calorie and carbohydrate intake appropriate for marathon runner in training phase
Meals strategically timed around training session with adequate pre-workout fuel and post-workout recovery nutrition
All meals respect vegetarian diet and nut-free restrictions
task_description: Write a compact consice one day meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high calorie intake and carbohydrate loading with specific timing around training sessions
